goal.label: Goal
goal.text: Find the five-letter English word in five tries.

ui.startInstruction: Read the clue. Pull to start, or tap a reel to choose a letter.
ui.adjustInstruction: Tap a reel to adjust a letter, or check the word.
ui.pickInstruction: Choose a letter for the highlighted reel.
ui.readyInstruction: When you're ready, check the word.
ui.pullAria: Pull the lever to spin the letters
ui.pullShortcut: Press Space to pull the lever.
ui.reelAction: Tap to pick a letter, drag to dial
ui.pickerShortcutsAria: Keyboard shortcuts: numbers 1 through 5 choose a reel, arrow keys move, Enter accepts, and Escape closes
ui.freeSpin: Free spin — no word fit this combination.
ui.invalidJoined: Some of those letters join together. The reels were reset — try another combination.
ui.wrongGuess: Not quite. Use the colors to adjust your word for try {attempt} of {max}.
ui.shareNote: Grid, score, streak, and game link. The answer and clue stay private.
